summary: The security-sensitive change is gate()'s lite_window_ok relaxation. It is correctly scoped: it skips ONLY the approved-plan and decomposition preconditions, ONLY when the caller passes lite_window_ok AND an open lite window exists; sign-off is never relaxed; only record_review passes the flag, so verify.py and record_test stay strict (asserted by test_lite_window_does_not_unlock_verify_or_test_recording). The lite window is a human-initiated, ledgered act (forge mode lite --by --reason), which is the trust anchor per 0031. The terra@high write path is sanctioned only inside an open lite window; raw codex exec stays hook-blocked; _lite_product_files applies the same product boundary as the planning lock (repo-kind aware).

non_blocking_findings.summary: The lite relaxation reads .factory/quickfix.json directly for the profile; the .factory hand-write guard already protects that file, and pr_ready refuses to ship with an open window, so a stale/forged lite window cannot ride into a shipped story. No exposure found.

residual_risks: A supervising human can hand-edit product code under a lite window, bypassing the terra@high model pin. This is an accepted 0031 consequence (the pin governs delegated fixes), captured by the file manifest + mandatory close review, and gated by human supervision — not an injection or privilege path.
